name: movie-to-excel
description: Turn a movie title or poster into a private, local-first Excel movie archive.

interface.shortDescription: Build a private local movie archive in Excel.
interface.longDescription: Identify a movie from a title or poster, verify its metadata, and generate a private local-first Excel archive without accounts, social features, or platform lock-in.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create an Excel movie record from the movie title or poster I provide.
